
## See also

* [straza](/reference/cli/straza/): Straza client: enroll this machine, wire the hooks and decide each tool call
* [straza trace off](/reference/cli/straza/straza_trace_off/): Close the debug window (the journal stays on)
* [straza trace on](/reference/cli/straza/straza_trace_on/): Open a debug window (default 1h, max 24h); the journal is always on
* [straza trace show](/reference/cli/straza/straza_trace_show/): Print the journal and debug records, oldest first
* [straza trace status](/reference/cli/straza/straza_trace_status/): Report the trace level in force, its source, the window and the file
